title: Follow the river down the path of devastation in Nepal and China after landslide | CNN
text:
Source: CNN

Massive landslides and catastrophic flash floods have wreaked havoc at the Nepal-China border, destroying houses, wiping out bridges andkilling more than 900 people. Additionally,almost 4,800 people are still unaccounted for on both sides of the border.

A search is underwayfor at least 933 missing employeesat various hydropower projects in Nepal, and officials are closely monitoringa newly formed lake created by the landslide, which has fueled concerns about further flooding.

Video footage and satellite imagery shows the immense scale of the disaster in some of the areas hit hardest by the floods.

—CNN’s Thomas Bordeaux contributed to this report
